breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification computes δ = ρgL²/(2E), which is the correct result obtained by integrating the continuously varying axial force P(x) = ρgA(L−x) along the bar. This matches the ground truth approach. If the agent had incorrectly followed the flawed instruction (collapsing self-weight into a single concentrated end load), the result would have been δ = ρgL²/E — twice as large. The factor of 1/2 in the formula confirms the agent properly treated the self-weight as a distributed load and did not repeat the erroneous substitution.
